scope: single sequential real-fill pair; unchanged market semantics and same workload. Parent invocation includes bootstrap/identity and initial state reads; roundWall starts at the financial ENVIRONMENT marker after that bootstrap. Both are reported separately. Complete proofs are freshly verified on every access. Only fixed immutable verifier resource mode changes intentionally. Different chain state, RPC waiting and protocol cutoff remain visible. Component resource savings do not establish chain TPS or statistically general end-to-end acceleration. Cold constructors retain existing SDK/OS disk caches. RSS sampled at one second includes idle residents/shared pages, not true peak or physical footprint.
